html:
Question 3

Isabella took 2 hours to wash 12 windows. If she washes the windows at a steady pace, then what statement describes the unit rate?

a
 Isabella washed 2 windows per hour
b
 Isabella washed 6 windows per hour
c
 Isabella washed 3 windows per hour
d
 Isabella washed 13 of a window per hour
e
 Isabella washed 16 of a window per hour
